notes: Covered all 9 Bundesländer: 24-h clinics in Wien (Vetmeduni, AniCura Erdberg, Vetklinikum, Döbling and Mauer on-call), NÖ (Hollabrunn, St. Pölten, Perchtoldsdorf, Dobersberg; Pegasus horses only), Burgenland (Parndorf, Neusiedl on-call), OÖ (Schwanenstadt, Sattledt, Wels, Steyr), Steiermark (Thalerhof, Muttendorf, Leoben), Vorarlberg (Cepicka phone 24h), Tirol (only a practice's 24h phone line). Duty rotas: Salzburg Kleintiernotruf + Innergebirge rota, Graz, Linz, Kärnten weekend duty, Innsbruck weekday-night line. No official small-animal rota found for Wien, NÖ, Burgenland, Vorarlberg (only farm animals) or Tirol-wide (pages blocked). No 24-h clinic in Kärnten (ORF Kärnten 10.02.2026) or Salzburg. Poison line: VIZ (01 406 43 43) does not say it advises on animal poisonings, so no poison_line entry. Not reachable / left: tieraerztekammer.at landing + Landesstellen pages, meintierdoktor.at (redirect blocked), tirol.gv.at Wochenenddienste/Sonntagsdienst pages and tierarzt-notdienst.tirol (blocked), Salzburg Q4 2026 PDFs, tierklinik-gilli.at (Bruck/Mur), tierklinik-erdmann.at (Klagenfurt, on the Kärnten rota), tierklinik-hainburg.at, tierklinik-seekirchen.at, tierklinik-planner.at (Dornbirn), badischl.vet (Tierklinik Bad Ischl, redirect loop; only a tourism listing), buchner-vet.at. Tourist areas still thin: St. Anton/Landeck, Ischgl/Paznaun, Sölden (only Tierklinik Imst nearby), Mayrhofen (Zell am Ziller only), Zell am See/Bad Gastein (Bruck rota practice only), Velden, Salzkammergut; more Graz, Salzburg-city, Innsbruck and Vorarlberg (Dornbirn/Feldkirch) practices could be added in a follow-up run. Follow-up 2026-11-02: Follow-up run 2026-11-02 (Tirol/Salzburg resorts, Kärnten lakes, Salzkammergut, Vorarlberg, extra Salzburg/Innsbruck/Graz practices). Added 52 entries: 1 duty_rota (Tirol-wide weekend small-animal line via tierarzt-notdienst.tirol, now reachable), 3 x 24 h (Tierklinik Bad Ischl 0-24 staffed; Tierarztpraxis Fügen and Tierarztpraxis Kraft Murau = phone on-call). Salzburg Q4 2026 duty PDFs not published/indexed (latest Q3 2026; undated 'Notdienste' PDFs still Q4 2025) — existing Salzburg rotas unchanged. Kärnten practices added from the tierarzt-ktn.at duty list carry phone only (no address), except Woschnjak and Schmidburg-Spendier whose addresses the list now gives. Several entries rely on official tourism-board/Gemeinde listings because the WebFetch tool only opens URLs surfaced by search. Not reachable/blocked: tirol.gv.at district vet lists (Schwaz, Landeck, Sprengeltierärzte) and Ötztal press release (robots), dr-geisler-mayrhofen.at, mivet.at (Landeck), hundkatzpferd.at, petdoctors.at (robots); tierklinik-seekirchen.at (client error); http-only sites loop (tierarztpraxis-obernosterer.at, tierarzt-villach-land.at, kleintierordination-traunsee.at, tierarzt-kufstein.at, miauwau.at Seefeld); badischl.vet, mountainvet.at, tierarzt-spittal.at, tierarztpraxis-brugger.at, tierarztpraxiseisl.at not openable (provenance). Still thin: St. Anton/Landeck/Ischgl/Paznaun (no source found; Tirol duty page says no small-animal duty in Landeck district), Seefeld (only Zirl), Saalbach (none found), Lech (Lech Zürs tourism lists no vet), Spittal/Millstätter See/Bad Kleinkirchheim (Das Tierärzteteam am Rathausplatz Spittal +43 4762 5248 seen only on herold.at — not added), Feldkirch town practices.
